paper_title: Combining Electronic and Steric Effects For Highly Stable Unsymmetric Pentacenes

knowledge_points.content: Unsymmetric 6,13-disubstituted pentacenes are synthesized through a sequential two-step addition of different organolithium reagents to 6,13-pentacenequinone, followed by reductive aromatization.
knowledge_points.evidence: 0.73 mL (1.2 mmol) nbutyllithium (1.6 M) in hexanes was added to a solution of 0.13 g (1.3 mmol) phenylacetylene... The reaction mixture was added dropwise to 0.4 g (1.30 mmol) of 6,13-pentacenequinone... 13-hydroxy-13-(phenylethynyl)pentacen-6(13H)-one... A 2-bromo-1,3-disubstituted benzene derivative was dissolved in dry THF. n-Butyllithium in hexanes was added... 13-hydroxy-13-(phenylethynyl)pentacen-6(13H)-one above was then added.

knowledge_points.content: The reductive aromatization of the dihydroxy or hydroxy-ketone pentacene intermediates is achieved using tin(II) chloride dihydrate in a 10% H2SO4 aqueous solution.
knowledge_points.evidence: The reaction mixture was then dissolved in THF and treated with 10% H2SO4 aqueous solution saturated with tin(II) chloride dihydrate and vigorously stirred at room temperature for 3 hours.

knowledge_points.content: The introduction of a phenylethynyl group at the 6-position of pentacene significantly lowers the LUMO level compared to the diphenyl-substituted counterpart, which enhances electronic stability.
knowledge_points.evidence: Table S1. Frontier molecular orbital energies... 1 [6,13-diphenylpentancene] LUMO -2.60 eV; 2 [6,13-bis(phenylethynyl)pentacenes] LUMO -3.02 eV; 3 [6-phenyl-13-(phenylethynyl)pentacene] LUMO -2.81 eV.

knowledge_points.content: Unsymmetric pentacenes containing both a phenylethynyl group and a 2,6-dialkylphenyl group (compounds 4 and 5) exhibit HOMO levels around -4.80 eV and LUMO levels around -2.83 eV.
knowledge_points.evidence: Table S1... 4: HOMO -4.80 eV, LUMO -2.83 eV; 5: HOMO -4.80 eV, LUMO -2.83 eV.

knowledge_points.content: Among the tested derivatives, 6-(2,6-diethylphenyl)-13-(phenylethynyl)pentacene (compound 5) shows the highest photostability when subjected to broadband visible light irradiation in air-equilibrated chloroform.
knowledge_points.evidence: Figure S3. Decomposition of pentacenes 1-5 in air-equilibrated CHCl3 at initial concentrations of 50 μM upon broadband visible light irradiation (λ > 400 nm)... [Compound 5 shows the slowest rate of degradation in the plot].

knowledge_points.content: The absence of aggregation in 6-phenyl-13-(phenylethynyl)pentacene (compound 3) solutions in chloroform is confirmed by normalized absorbance spectra that remain consistent over a 100-fold concentration range.
knowledge_points.evidence: Figure S2. Normalized absorbance spectra of compound 3 over 100-fold range of concentration, which indicates of lack of aggregation at these concentrations.

knowledge_points.content: The photostability kinetics of pentacene derivatives were evaluated using methylene blue as a photosensitizer to generate singlet oxygen (1O2) under 665 nm irradiation.
knowledge_points.evidence: Irradiation of the methylene blue photosensitizer to generate 1O2 was performed with a 200 W Hg/Xe lamp... with a 665 nm high-pass filter... 9, 10-diphenylanthracene was used as reference for 1-5.

knowledge_points.content: 6-(2,6-diethylphenyl)-13-(phenylethynyl)pentacene (compound 5) crystallizes in the monoclinic P2/n space group with a unit cell volume of 1557.11(17) Å³ at 100 K.
knowledge_points.evidence: Table S2. Crystal data and structure refinement for JZ_Pentacene... Space group P2/n... Volume 1557.11(17) A3... Temperature 100(2) K.

knowledge_points.content: Frontier molecular orbital energies for the pentacene derivatives were calculated using Density Functional Theory (DFT) at the B3LYP/6-311G(d,p) level.
knowledge_points.evidence: All DFT calculations were performed using the B3LYP functional and the 6-311(d,p) basis set using the Gaussian 09 package... Table S1. Frontier molecular orbital energies... determined by DFT calculations at the B3LYP/6-311G(d,p) level.

knowledge_points.content: The photo-oxidation of 6-phenyl-13-(phenylethynyl)pentacene (compound 3) results in the formation of an endoperoxide (3-O2), as confirmed by HRMS with a found mass of 487.1697 for the (M+H)+ ion.
knowledge_points.evidence: Figure S1. 1H and 13C NMR of 3 and 3-O2 in CDCl3. HRMS calcd for 3-O2: C36H22O2 (M+H)+, 487.1693; found, 487.1697.
